description: Kostenfreies Trinkwasser (Refill) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Freistaat Sachsen. Ausreichend und regelmäßig Trinken ist wichtig - auch unterwegs. Gehen bei einem Ausflug in der Stadt unerwartet die Getränke aus, kann an verschiedenen Stellen kostenfrei Leitungswasser in die eigene Flasche oder den Mehrwegbecher nachgefüllt werden. Das hilft Abfälle zu vermeiden und Ressourcen zu schonen. Coverage: Freistaat Sachsen. The portal files it under the publisher Freistaat Sachsen. Its tags are lokal, opendata. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
